exposure: postoperative i.m. injections of ampicillin-trihydrate 20% for 3 d (10 mg/kg, twice a day)
Exploratory laparotomy with no antibiotic prophylaxis (ELN) vs. exploratory laparotomy with single ampicillin-sodium injection (ELL)
Cesarean section with single ampicillin-sodium injection (CSL) vs. cesarean section with ampicillin-sodium injection and postoperative ampicillin-trihydrate injections (CSH)
cohort: 210 cows undergoing cesarean section (n=100) or exploratory laparotomy (n=110)
finding: Reducing antibiotic prophylaxis in cows undergoing cesarean section and exploratory laparotomy is possible, with postoperative antibiotic intervention effectively treating the low number of clinically detected complications.
